caption: The drawing consists of two sketched objects, both resembling large, squared jars or stoneware crocks, each with a slightly sloped shoulder and a short neck. The top object is outlined in black with a thick rim and a small, arched handle set into the upper part of the body. It is unadorned and positioned centrally on the page. The bottom object is also outlined in black but includes additional details: at the upper rim, there is black text reading, "C. BYKELFER'S SONS, 1734 FULTON ST. BROOKLYN," and below it is a circled number “3.” On the body of the jar, beneath the text and offset slightly to the left, there is a blue brushwork design resembling a stylized floral motif or leafy branch, composed of flowing strokes. The background of the drawing is an off-white or beige color, and the composition is vertically aligned, with the two jars stacked one above the other and spaced apart on the page.
title: Jar
